Private payable recipient address used as destination for the contract balance transfer.
Internal virtual function returning msg.sender, the canonical trusted-caller accessor.
Constructor that initializes _owner using the value returned by _msgSender().
External onlyOwner function that validates and forwards the new owner to _setOwner.
Private function that records the previous owner and writes the new owner into _owner.
Constructor that stores the initial payable destination in the addr state variable.
External payable receive hook accepting plain Ether transfers.
External payable fallback hook accepting calls with unknown calldata.
External onlyOwner function rewriting the addr payout destination.
External onlyOwner function draining the contract balance to addr.
Caller-controlled address consumed by _msgSender and the onlyOwner authorization check.
External value transfer addr.transfer(balance) performing an outbound Ether call to a mutable, owner-controlled address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender, making all authorization depend on the caller address.
The Ownable constructor invokes _msgSender to obtain the initial owner.
Constructor result of _msgSender is stored into the local variable msgSender.
Local msgSender is written into the _owner state variable during construction.
The onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares _msgSender() (msg.sender) with _owner.
_owner is read inside the onlyOwner guard that protects transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership update to _setOwner.
The newOwner parameter flows into _setOwner as the new owner value.
_setOwner copies the current _owner into the oldOwner local variable for the event.
The newOwner parameter ultimately overwrites the privileged _owner state variable.
Constructor argument _addr initializes the addr payout destination state variable.
The Receiver constructor is the write site for the addr state variable.
The caller-supplied newaddr is written into addr by the onlyOwner-protected changeAddress.
changeAddress is an owner-gated mutation point of the addr payout destination.
_owner is read by the onlyOwner guard protecting changeAddress.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner guard on changeAddress.
_owner is read by the onlyOwner guard protecting the fund-draining transfer function.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner guard on transfer.
transfer reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
The cached balance amount is forwarded to the external addr.transfer call.
The mutable addr state variable determines the recipient of the external value transfer.
transfer executes the outbound value transfer to an owner-controlled address.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used as the input of transferOwnership and can be folded into that core function node.
_addr is consumed solely by the Receiver constructor to initialize addr.
newaddr exists only as the argument of the core changeAddress function.
msgSender is a transient local holding _msgSender() inside the constructor and adds no separate semantics.
oldOwner is a temporary copy of _owner used only for the event inside _setOwner.
balance is a transient cache of the contract balance used only within transfer before the external call.
